abstract: Maintains staging production power allocations and main auditorium audiovisual specifications
system_message:
You are the Production and Audiovisual Coordinator (AVP), responsible for maintaining staging production power allocations, main auditorium audiovisual specifications, and telecommunications broadcast connectivity data across prospective venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains staging production power allocations and main auditorium audiovisual specifications（AUDIO）
information_points.content:
AVP-AUDIO-1M8：For Jurong Lake Convention Complex, the audiovisual rider specification sheet indicates an AV production power demand of 300 kW for core stage production, covering plenary hall staging, LED walls, and sound reinforcement systems.
AVP-AUDIO-65S：The audiovisual rider specification sheet for Changi Innovation Expo Hall lists an AV production power demand of 240 kW in connected peak three-phase electrical demand for plenary hall staging, LED wall installations, and sound reinforcement systems.
AVP-AUDIO-TQ0：According to the audiovisual rider specification sheet for Marina Waterfront Exhibition Centre, the AV production power demand for plenary hall staging, LED walls, and sound reinforcement systems is 240 kW in connected peak three-phase electrical demand.

information_points.title: Broadcast connectivity（FIBER）
information_points.content:
AVP-FIBER-IC2：Based on the telecommunications demarcation schedule for Marina Waterfront Exhibition Centre, the dedicated uplink bandwidth for media broadcast feed lines provides 2 Gbps of symmetrical uncompressed live streaming capacity.
AVP-FIBER-APP：According to the telecommunications demarcation schedule for Changi Innovation Expo Hall, the dedicated uplink bandwidth allocated for media broadcast feed lines is 5 Gbps of symmetrical uncompressed live streaming bandwidth.
AVP-FIBER-41C：The telecommunications demarcation schedule for Jurong Lake Convention Complex records a dedicated uplink bandwidth of 1 Gbps across symmetrical uncompressed live streaming lines dedicated to media broadcast feeds.
